repoPath.description: Local git checkout to diff. Optional when unifiedDiff is supplied. Dry-run only; sandbox may not contain the buyer's repo.

unifiedDiff.description: Precomputed unified diff text. Use this when the agent should not run git.

baseRef.description: Git base ref (default HEAD~1 when repoPath is used).

headRef.description: Git head ref (default HEAD when repoPath is used).

acceptanceNotes.description: Human or machine notes that belong in the acceptance report.

buyerCriteria.description: Array of local checks; no execution or buyer authority

summary.description: One-line packaging result. Always notes paidModelCalls=0.

commitRange.description: Requested range label; acceptanceReport states whether Git ran and dot semantics

diffBytes.description: Byte length of the captured unified diff.

paidModelCalls.description: Always 0. This agent does not call paid models.

acceptanceReport.description: Machine-readable acceptance report (checks, notes, cash boundary).

evidencePack.description: Combined pack: unified diff text plus acceptance report.

structuralChecksPass.description: Local structural checks only, never buyer acceptance

grexalPaidExecution.description: Always false; no paid execution evidence
